verdicts.reason: A really does rearrange for the taller canvas: a larger headline, a stacked subhead and CTA on a shared left edge, and the logo balanced on the right. Its flaws are the orphaned word 'night.' on the subhead's second line, the logo moving from the lead position to the right, and the logo column floating without aligning to the text block. B is the original banner pasted into the vertical middle at the same small sizes, leaving large dead bands above and below. Its subhead sits loosely below the headline and the content isn't scaled up to use the extra height, so it reads as an unadapted copy.
